source_note: This evidence was recorded from the uncommitted change; file SHA256 values identify the tested source preserved by the containing commit.

checks.name: original response-loss regression
checks.detail: Actual POST committed, its browser response aborted, and the original control remained enabled instead of disabled.

checks.name: post-delete session race regression
checks.detail: AFTER DELETE trigger expires session after actual removal; 409 must remain UNKNOWN rather than a confirmed rejection.

checks.name: compiled browser regression
checks.command: BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5296 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/guest-save-uncertain.spec.ts tests/e2e/guest-save-merge.spec.ts tests/e2e/guest-response-copy.spec.ts
checks.scope: Before/after-commit response loss, repeated read failure, initial/hydration read lock, local synthetic login handoff, reload, and mobile place-key isolation. The two skipped cases are mobile-only checks in the desktop project.

checks.name: confirmed rejection browser check
checks.command: BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5296 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/guest-save-uncertain.spec.ts --grep 'pre-write rejection'
checks.scope: This check was added after the preceding browser batch and run for both projects.

checks.detail: Review found post-write409 misclassification; choiceWriteStarted now makes all post-start errors UNKNOWN.

unscoped_attempt.detail: The extra separator caused an unfiltered run; only this owned process was stopped.
